lines.text: Many learners say: I need to make an essay tonight.
Better: I need to write an essay tonight.
We write an essay. We do not make one.
Write! I need to write an essay tonight.

data.wrong: I need to make an essay tonight.
data.right: I need to write an essay tonight.
data.why: We write an essay. We do not make one.
